chunks: As for the unbelievers, if they had all that is in the earth and twice as much with it, to ransom themselves from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection, it would not be accepted from them, and they will have a painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: Will wealth save disbelievers from punishment on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of material ransom (kaffarah) when faith is absent, contrasting with the concept of intercession (shafa'ah) which is specific to the righteous. It serves as a warning that worldly accumulation holds no value in the divine court without spiritual sincerity, emphasizing that salvation depends on one's relationship with God rather than mere possession of wealth.
